info.title: Stooq Public Quote Downloads
info.description: Provider-owned, undocumented Stooq download URLs observed on public quote pages and in existing clients. They are not a formally versioned developer API. As observed on 2026-08-10, the latest-quote URL returned HTTP 404 and the historical-download URL returned a JavaScript browser-verification page instead of CSV; consumers must inspect status and Content-Type before parsing.

get.description: Legacy latest-quote CSV download URL. The query shape and field-code convention are inferred from historical clients; Stooq does not publish a current developer contract. A direct request on 2026-08-10 returned HTTP 404 with an HTML page, so no successful CSV response is currently verified.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: One or more Stooq ticker identifiers, historically separated by commas. Examples include `aapl.us` for Apple on the US market. Symbol suffixes are provider-specific and are not exhaustively documented here.

schema.description: One or more Stooq ticker identifiers, historically separated by commas. Examples include `aapl.us` for Apple on the US market. Symbol suffixes are provider-specific and are not exhaustively documented here.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Compact ordered field-selection code used by the legacy CSV endpoint. The example `sd2t2ohlcvp` is observed in existing requests; individual letters are not asserted as a stable public enum because the provider has no current formal documentation.

schema.description: Compact ordered field-selection code used by the legacy CSV endpoint. The example `sd2t2ohlcvp` is observed in existing requests; individual letters are not asserted as a stable public enum because the provider has no current formal documentation.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Presence-style legacy flag requesting a CSV header. Historical URLs commonly contain bare `h` rather than `h=true`; generic OpenAPI clients may serialize this boolean differently.

schema.description: Presence-style legacy flag requesting a CSV header. Historical URLs commonly contain bare `h` rather than `h=true`; generic OpenAPI clients may serialize this boolean differently.

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: Requested output format. Only CSV is evidenced for this URL.

schema.description: Requested output format. Only CSV is evidenced for this URL.

200.description: Historically expected CSV response; not reproduced on 2026-08-10.

illustrativeLegacyShape.summary: Illustrative legacy column shape only; not a response captured in the current verification

text/html.example: <meta charset=utf-8><title>Stooq</title>...The page you requested does not exist or has been moved...

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Used by FiApp historically; provider verification on 2026-08-10 returned a Stooq 404 page.
get.x-pontx-proxy-disabled-reason: This URL currently returns Stooq's 404 page, so proxy execution is disabled.

get.description: Legacy historical OHLCV CSV download URL linked conceptually from provider-owned historical-data pages. A direct automated request on 2026-08-10 received HTTP 200 `text/html` containing a JavaScript proof-of-work browser check, not CSV. The Hub does not attempt to solve or bypass that check.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Single provider-specific Stooq ticker identifier, for example `aapl.us`.

schema.description: Single provider-specific Stooq ticker identifier, for example `aapl.us`.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Provider-owned historical page; automated requests currently receive Stooq's JavaScript verification page instead of CSV.
get.x-pontx-proxy-disabled-reason: Stooq currently requires JavaScript browser verification, which Hub does not bypass.

LatestQuoteCsv.title: LatestQuoteCsv
LatestQuoteCsv.description: Legacy CSV text. Column order is selected by `f`; the illustrated header corresponds to `sd2t2ohlcvp`. This wire format was not reproduced during the current verification.

HistoricalQuoteCsv.title: HistoricalQuoteCsv
HistoricalQuoteCsv.description: Historical OHLCV CSV text with header `Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume`. The current unauthenticated response is browser-verification HTML, not this representation.

StooqNotFoundHtml.title: StooqNotFoundHtml
StooqNotFoundHtml.description: Stooq-branded HTML page returned with HTTP 404 for the removed latest-quote URL.
StooqNotFoundHtml.example: <meta charset=utf-8><title>Stooq</title>...The page you requested does not exist or has been moved...

BrowserVerificationHtml.title: BrowserVerificationHtml
BrowserVerificationHtml.description: HTTP-200 no-store HTML containing a JavaScript SHA-256 proof-of-work challenge and a no-JavaScript warning. This is an anti-automation response, not quote data; clients should not bypass it automatically.
BrowserVerificationHtml.example: <!DOCTYPE html><html>...<noscript>This site requires JavaScript to verify your browser. Please enable JavaScript and reload.</noscript>...
